sourceSnapshots.content:
# What are the network and tokens supported for Onchain's native Swap?

Onchain's native Swap currently supports the following blockchains:

- Cronos

- Ethereum

- BNB Smart Chain

- Fantom

- Avalanche

- Polygon

- Gnosis

- Arbitrum

- Optimism

- Solana

The tokens supported are backed by the DEXes used to support the underlying trade. Onchain's swap function is powered by:

1. DeFi Swap

2. 1inch V4

3. PancakeSwap

4. SpookySwap

5. TraderJoe

6. Sushiswap

7. VVS Finance

8. Velodrome Finance

9. Jupiter

sourceSemantics.root: Own direct CroDefiSwapRouter02 factory-derived AMM router; each pair swap receives new bytes(0), not a user-supplied flash callback payload. Full flattened compilation includes CroDefiSwapLibrary, interfaces, SafeMath and TransferHelper.
sourceSemantics.fundingAndRecipient: Token swaps/adds transferFrom msg.sender into factory-derived pair. Liquidity redemption transfers caller LP to pair then burn(to). Native conversion through immutable WETH; designated to is financial output recipient.
sourceSemantics.feesRounding: Library uses 997/1000 input factor, integer output floor, exact-output input floor+1. LP ratio selection/initial liquidity, refunds and fee-on-transfer residual-balance caveats are documented in warnings.
sourceSemantics.signingBoundary: Three WithPermit methods invoke pair permit for msg.sender/router allowance, so all excluded. No new signer, backend typed data, arbitrary executor or aggregator calldata path admitted.

limitations: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory.

Ethereum own CroDefiSwapRouter02 only, not Onchain wallet aggregator execution. Primary crypto.com URL currently redirects to defi-swap.org; its current frontend exports this exact ROUTER_ADDRESS. Explorer reports Exact Match while Sourcify reports creationMatch=match/runtimeMatch=match, not exact_match; both are preserved without upgrading the Sourcify grade.

Non-proxy direct router; immutable factory 0x9deb29c9a4c7a88a3c0257393b7f3335338d9a9d and WETH 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2 derive direct AMM pairs with the source-bound init-code hash. There is no caller-chosen executable target, payload or flash callback data. Pair factory, tokens and WETH are dependencies, not a full independent runtime attestation.

Caller chooses token path/assets, amounts, limits, recipient and deadline. Inputs pull only msg.sender tokens/LP or consume msg.value; this grants no allowance/permit/signing authority. All three WithPermit functions are excluded. Native input wraps ETH, native output unwraps WETH; nonpayable methods require zero native value. Native recipient or refund rejection can revert.

Swap exact-input calculations round output down with the source 997/1000 AMM factor; exact-output input rounds up by adding one. Multi-hop calculation reads reserves, final output minimum/input maximum and expiry apply. Quotes, reserve state and token behavior can change; token quantities use each token decimals and ETH uses wei.

Add-liquidity creates a factory pair if absent, optimizes token ratio against reserves, pulls chosen token quantities and mints LP to recipient. addLiquidityETH refunds unused ETH to caller. Initial empty-pair branch uses desired amounts directly rather than separately enforcing amountAMin/amountBMin. Remove-liquidity transfers caller LP to the pair and burns for recipient; output minima apply before any token transfer-tax loss.

Fee-on-transfer token-to-token and native-to-token swaps enforce recipient balance delta minimums. Token-to-ETH supporting variant unwraps the entire WETH balance held by the router, not only a measured per-call delta. Supporting ETH LP removal sends the router entire token balance to recipient; amountTokenMin is checked on pair burn amount before a possible output transfer tax, not recipient net. Do not pre-fund router/pairs; residual-balance capture is not a separate capability.

Ethereum own CroDefiSwapRouter02 only, not Onchain wallet aggregator execution. Primary crypto.com URL currently redirects to defi-swap.org; its current frontend exports this exact ROUTER_ADDRESS. Explorer reports Exact Match while Sourcify reports creationMatch=match/runtimeMatch=match, not exact_match; both are preserved without upgrading the Sourcify grade.

Non-proxy direct router; immutable factory 0x9deb29c9a4c7a88a3c0257393b7f3335338d9a9d and WETH 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2 derive direct AMM pairs with the source-bound init-code hash. There is no caller-chosen executable target, payload or flash callback data. Pair factory, tokens and WETH are dependencies, not a full independent runtime attestation.

Caller chooses token path/assets, amounts, limits, recipient and deadline. Inputs pull only msg.sender tokens/LP or consume msg.value; this grants no allowance/permit/signing authority. All three WithPermit functions are excluded. Native input wraps ETH, native output unwraps WETH; nonpayable methods require zero native value. Native recipient or refund rejection can revert.

Swap exact-input calculations round output down with the source 997/1000 AMM factor; exact-output input rounds up by adding one. Multi-hop calculation reads reserves, final output minimum/input maximum and expiry apply. Quotes, reserve state and token behavior can change; token quantities use each token decimals and ETH uses wei.

Add-liquidity creates a factory pair if absent, optimizes token ratio against reserves, pulls chosen token quantities and mints LP to recipient. addLiquidityETH refunds unused ETH to caller. Initial empty-pair branch uses desired amounts directly rather than separately enforcing amountAMin/amountBMin. Remove-liquidity transfers caller LP to the pair and burns for recipient; output minima apply before any token transfer-tax loss.

Fee-on-transfer token-to-token and native-to-token swaps enforce recipient balance delta minimums. Token-to-ETH supporting variant unwraps the entire WETH balance held by the router, not only a measured per-call delta. Supporting ETH LP removal sends the router entire token balance to recipient; amountTokenMin is checked on pair burn amount before a possible output transfer tax, not recipient net. Do not pre-fund router/pairs; residual-balance capture is not a separate capability.
